title: Hospitality as Christian Witness
definition: Hospitality as Christian Witness is welcoming others in Christ's name so the grace of God becomes visible through practical love.
summary: Hospitality turns homes, tables, and time into instruments of Gospel love.
christFocus: Jesus Christ welcomed sinners and strangers, and His people reflect His welcome through generous hospitality.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Hospitality as Christian Witness describes a Spirit-formed pattern of life for those who belong to Jesus Christ. Christian living is not an attempt to earn salvation but the grateful response of people who have been saved by grace and called to walk with the Lord.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can grow in holiness, endurance, love, wisdom, worship, and mission. It touches the heart, the mind, the tongue, relationships, daily habits, and faithful obedience in ordinary life.

The emphasis of this doctrine is hospitality turns homes, tables, and time into instruments of gospel love.. It points disciples away from self-reliance and toward abiding dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because discipleship can become shallow when it is reduced to information, emotion, or outward activity alone. Hospitality as Christian Witness teaches believers how grace becomes visible in daily conduct, perseverance, relationships, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to form this truth in you through Scripture, prayer, repentance, and faithful practice. Let hospitality as christian witness shape how you think, speak, serve, endure, forgive, and represent Christ in the places God has assigned to you.
